plants.name: Prunus mume
plants.description: Ume trees are covered in fragrant blossoms while the last cold days of winter linger. The flowers have a sweet, spicy scent. They open on bare branches and sometimes appear against late snow.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late January to March, with peak bloom in many areas around late February to mid-March
plants.location: Japan, including the Kantō and Kansai regions, as well as China and Korea
plants.funFact: Ume blooms weeks before cherry blossoms, so in East Asia it is a traditional sign that spring is on its way. The fruit is used to make umeboshi (pickled plums) and umeshu (plum liqueur).

plants.name: Narcissus pseudonarcissus
plants.description: Wild daffodils carpet woodlands and meadows with pale yellow petals around a deeper golden trumpet. They are smaller and more delicate than most garden varieties. Large drifts of them light up the end of winter.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late February to April, with peak bloom commonly in March
plants.location: Western Europe, including England, Wales and the Netherlands
plants.funFact: All parts of the plant contain alkaloids. One of them, galantamine, was developed into a medicine used to treat symptoms of Alzheimer's disease.

plants.name: Amaryllis belladonna
plants.description: Bare, sturdy stems rise from the ground with no leaves, and each carries a cluster of fragrant, trumpet-shaped pink blooms. The flowers appear at the end of the Southern Hemisphere summer, when the leaves have died back.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late summer to early autumn in the Southern Hemisphere, roughly February to April
plants.location: Western Cape of South Africa, and gardens in southern Australia
plants.funFact: It flowers without leaves, which gives it the nickname "naked lady". Leaves grow later, in the cooler months, and die back again before the next flowering.
